config.initialization: All arms continue the identical selected N2 epoch22 task checkpoint. Both new cardinality residual readouts are zero initialized. Optimizer states are freshly initialized identically. This is a local adaptation comparison, not an independent from-scratch result.
config.training: Common 20-epoch full encoder and TabM adaptation, same Train waveforms, losses, noise probabilities, dropout and seed13. Epoch0 is eligible for Val selection. No architecture, features, data split or evaluation noise changes.
config.selection: 0.5 original Val mean(Single,Double,background) + 0.5 mean of that score over five noisy conditions; tie original overall ACC. One trained checkpoint per arm; Test only after selection is sealed.
config.prediction: Per-member seven-set logits plus a learned group-constant residual for cardinality0/1/2; mean member softmax and argmax. C0 has no residual; C1 reads the final hidden block; C2 reads the first hidden block. No true count is used at inference.
